newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX nears key support, bounce likely.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX nears key support, bounce likely.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ NYMEX crude oil heating oil and gasoline futures have fallen back towards critical support levels and are expected to bounce back from them.
+ But a break below around $19.40-$19.44 on the June crude contract is expected to usher in a new period of lower prices.
NYMEX crude oil futures are sitting above nearby support levels which are likely to cause a bounce upwards in the short term, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
June NYMEX crude closed three cents a barrel firmer on Monday at $19.63, while June heating oil was 0.03 cents a gallon up at 53.05 and June gasoline was 0.02 cents up at 60.54.
"We are right at the bounds for all three markets," said Claudia LaCovey at Analytics Research Corp in Bethesda, Maryland. "A break below these critical levels means the downtrend will resume."
Using her company's proprietary chart technique, she said the most important support for June crude was $19.38-$19.44. This also corresponded roughly to the $19.44 low on Friday.
"It appears these lows are holding and I am looking for prices to head up," she said and added that prices would have to move over $19.88-$19.90 to rise significantly higher on Tuesday.
An eventual target for an upwards move above that lay at $21.26. "That is the next strong resistance level."
She saw the downside bounds for June heating oil lying between 52.70-52.89 cents a gallon, and expected the market to bounce from these levels.
"This level must hold for the immediate updraft to continue... it appears to be putting in a swing low," she said.
Gasoline futures charts showed a similar picture, with critical key support at 60.15 cents.
Refco Inc. saw support for June crude first at $19.55 and then, more strongly, at $19.44.
"Resistance is seen at Friday's high of $19.90 with a break showing a move to $20.53," their daily report said.
Gasoline would find minor support at 60.20 and then 59.40 to 59.60.
-- Nicholas Shaxson, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8167
